visible_text: 決まったことを待っています…
やることを待っています…
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く
AI が見ている資料 ― まだありません

answers.q1: Only weakly. A timer bar at top-left says 録音中 (recording) 00:02, and the panel title reads 01:54 の会議 ("01:54 meeting") — but that title is just an elapsed/start time, not a meeting name, participant list, or calendar event. There is no app/platform icon (Zoom, Meet, Teams), no device name, and no indication of where the audio input is coming from (mic vs system audio vs a call). So I can tell it is currently recording live audio for some meeting, but not which meeting or where the audio originates.
answers.q2: The AI's material is explicitly labeled at the bottom: 'AI が見ている資料 ― まだありません' (materials the AI is looking at — none yet). So it's clear there is a concept of reference documents feeding the AI, and it's clear that right now there are none.
answers.q3: Mostly one surface, but the black pill-shaped control bar at the very top (with record/pause/comment/expand/more/stop icons) reads as a separate floating overlay sitting on top of the main white panel rather than being integrated into it — it has its own rounded shape, dark color, and drop shadow distinct from the panel below. So it leans toward 'one main window plus a small floating toolbar' rather than a single unified surface, though it is not multiple full stacked windows.
answers.q4: The recording status/timer (録音中 00:02) and the meeting heading (01:54 の会議) are the most prominent items, followed by the empty transcript panel on the right (まだ発話がありません) — together they establish 'a meeting is being recorded live and nothing has been captured yet.'
answers.q5: Yes: (1) the meeting title '01:54 の会議' is just a time stamp, not an identifying name, so it doesn't answer 'which meeting'; (2) there is terminology overlap — the left column has sections '決まったこと' (decided things) and 'やること' (things to do), while the right side has buttons labeled '決定事項' (decisions) and 'アクション' (actions) — two different Japanese terms for what appear to be the same two concepts, which could read as redundant/inconsistent naming; (3) the floating black toolbar at the top feels slightly detached from the panel beneath it, raising the question of whether it's part of the same surface or a separate control window.

weaknesses.what: Meeting is identified only by a timestamp ('01:54 の会議'), with no meeting name, participant, calendar link, or audio-source indicator (mic vs system audio vs call app)
weaknesses.fix: Show the actual meeting/event title when available, and a small source indicator (e.g. app icon or 'System Audio' / 'Microphone') near the recording status

weaknesses.what: The dark floating pill toolbar at the very top visually separates from the white panel below via distinct shape, color, and shadow
weaknesses.fix: Either dock the toolbar flush into the panel's top edge with matching background, or keep it visually consistent (e.g. same corner radius/color language) so it reads as one continuous control strip

weaknesses.what: Two different word pairs are used for what look like the same two concepts: 決まったこと/決定事項 (decisions) and やること/アクション (action items)
weaknesses.fix: Standardize on one term per concept across the transcript panel and the button row
